verdict.rationale: Substantive guidance text was pulled from several public pages: the Division's main page (nj.gov/treasury/revenue), gettingregistered.shtml, and the njportal.com BusinessRegistration and BusinessFormation landing pages. That implies the public reading surface returns readable content without a login or key, and no evidence shows a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA. The reachability is inferred from extracted content rather than documented, so confidence is medium. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of fetches with an identified agent user agent, any robots/bot-policy evidence, and confirmation that the njportal.com pages render server-side rather than through a JS shell.
